_readme: LEVEL 3 GUIDE (T02 opening): same format as Tutorials/Level_01/guide.json. Arthur stays the guide.
Arrows only for new places: Bea's plaza table (a runtime Level3Gameplay target). The office and reception are known places (no office waypoints).

Level 3 flags (Level3Checkpointer.Flag): assignmentReceived (the reception assignment is committed; Bea's records are next), calculatorUp (the calculator is lifted at the desk), beaRecordsCollected (Bea's handover is committed), beaIntroDone (T04 buildup: Bea offered her organizer, or a restore skipped her first-encounter steps), atBeaTable (seated at her table). Cues: BeaTableSeated, BeaRecordRead. Legacy flags toolPractice, practiceFirstTape and practiceDone remain readable but no lesson uses them.

T04 buildup (4 November 2026): Arthur says nothing between Bea's handover and her Help Bea / Later offer: her envelope ('Open Bea's records') and her record ('Inspect a record') carry their own first-person prompts. bea-records waits for that offer and for the player to be standing; worksheet-intro starts at the first seat and no longer waits for bea-records. T05 replaced worksheet-intro's pages with its first-record steps (Feed the record / Choose where it belongs / Pull to file) on the same flag:atBeaTable entry.

T05 paper machine (4 November 2026): worksheet-intro waits for cue:MachineFed (a record half-fed), cue:MachineChosen (the first selector choice) and cue:WorksheetFiled (raised only after a lever filing is saved). worksheet-notes (same id) is now the Why? hint: flag:machineWhy (R6/R7 loaded with a treatment, no reason yet), waits for cue:MachineReasonChosen. machine-batch-filed: flag:machineBatchFiled (seated, every record of the open batch filed; T06 owns Check batch). Other flags: machineLoaded; worksheetDrafted (all seven filed with both reasons, saved). Cue MachineRecalled (a tab recalled). Each page waits for the player's own action and never names a treatment or reason; the old board's flags/cues (worksheetUp, worksheetAllPlaced, WorksheetLifted, WorksheetStripLifted, WorksheetStripPlaced, WorksheetNoteAnswered) stay readable for legacy only.

Revised T06 paper machine (5 November 2026): machine-batch-filed now points to CHECK BATCH and waits for cue:MachineBatchChecked or cue:MachineBatchAccepted (raised only after a saved check). worksheet-check (same id) is the look-again lesson: flag:machineLookAgain (seated, the open batch's last check marked a decision that is still as checked), waits for cue:MachineRecalled then a saved recheck. worksheet-corrections (same id) is the first accepted batch: flag:machineAccepted. worksheet-ready: flag:worksheetReady (all three batches accepted, saved), cue:MachineSummaryRead when the folded summary is opened (a preview), then flag:worksheetCollected. worksheet-subtotals now waits for flag:worksheetUp (the retired board only), so a revised run never shows tape lessons. Other T06 flags: machineChecked, machineSummary. No page names a treatment, reason or total.

T06 check flags: worksheetCalcUp (the calculator stands beside the sheet at Bea's table), worksheetTapes (both subtotal tapes attached and current), worksheetChecked (the first complete check is saved), worksheetCorrecting (WorksheetCorrections), worksheetReady (every decision checks out, saved), worksheetCollected (the checked worksheet is collected, saved with its rewards). Cues (Level3WorksheetDesk): WorksheetCalcUp, WorksheetCalcSource, WorksheetTapePrinted, WorksheetTapeAttached, WorksheetChecked, WorksheetHint. No page names an answer; the check result itself is the board's and Arthur's line.

T07 computation flags: beaComputation (Bea's computation phase), computationTotals (both totals picked), computationTaxable (a Taxable income tape is attached), computationRule (a rate band is picked), computationTaxDue (taxable income and tax due both had current tapes, saved), calculatorUp (the desk tools are lifted). Cues (Level3DeskCalculator): ComputationTotalChosen, ComputationRuleChosen, ComputationSourceUsed, ComputationTapeAttached. No page names a band, a total or a value; the book sections carry the method.

T08 credit flags: beaInOffice (Bea waits in the conference room), certificateReceived (her certificate handover is saved), creditExplained (her question's right answer is saved), computationCredit (a certificate amount is linked to Tax credits), computationPayable (credit linked and a current Remaining payable tape, saved), certificateUp (the certificate is held up). Cues: CertificateRead (Level3CertificatePaper), ComputationCreditChosen (Level3DeskCalculator). The conference room is a known place: no arrow. No page names the credit amount or the balance; Section 9 carries the method.

T09 review flags: beaStamped (the stamp covers the current sheet), beaStampStale (the sheet changed after it), beaReviewReturned (the last decided hand-in was returned), beaHeld (the last one was a justified hold), beaApproved (the approval is saved), reviewClockOn (Bea's review clock runs). Cues: StampPicked, SheetStamped (Level3DeskCalculator), BeaReviewReturned, BeaReviewApproved (Level3Audit). The Auditor is a known place: no arrow. No page names a line's value; Section 10 carries the method.

Revision (3 November 2026): the T03 budget practice lessons are retired with the practice itself; after the assignment Arthur points to Bea (bea-assignment). Revised T03: the calculator is introduced at its first office use: calculator-lesson (flag:calculatorLesson: the example card is up at Bea's computation before calculatorTaught is saved) waits for the player's own source tap, = and attach; it is implied once calculatorTaught is saved, so it never repeats. Flags calculatorLesson, calculatorTaught.
A resumed chapter marks the welcome and the tasks it has passed as already shown (Level3ChapterRules.ImpliedLessons), so they never replay.

T14 closing flags: closingFinding (Bea's draft question is next), findingRecorded (her supported finding is saved), messageRead (Quax's message is saved; the chapter result is pending), chapterResultPending, chapterComplete (the result's Continue is saved). closing-finding and closing-message are one short hint each; the chapter result itself is the existing result card.

Teaching pass (6 November 2026): worksheet-intro now runs on the practice packet's first slip (the stand card reads Practice 1 of 4; the packet always precedes Bea's first record) and its pull page also accepts cue:PracticeSlipFiled (a right practice pull; a wrong one raises cue:PracticeSlipRetry). sorting-practice: flag:sortingPractice (seated, the packet is due), waits for flag:sortingTaught (its one saved milestone). The desk examples reuse the calculator lesson's cues: tax-table-lesson (flag:taxLesson, the Practice Design Studio card is up) and withholding-lesson (flag:creditLesson) wait for the player's own source tap and for flag:taxTaught / flag:creditTaught. computation-rule now waits for flag:bandStep and credit-link for flag:creditStep (Bea's own step, once its example is done or was never due). Pages name the method, never Bea's band, credit or result.

Follow-up (6 November 2026, Level 2's watch-then-try pattern): Arthur first demonstrates each new teaching task himself in his bubble while the tools move on their own (the practice slips at Bea's table; each desk example). flag:atBeaTable, flag:sortingPractice and flag:calculatorLesson / flag:taxLesson / flag:creditLesson are false while his demonstration runs, so these hint pages are the player's turn. flag:sortingDemoSeen: the slip demonstration was watched (saved). His per-step lines and tips are Level3BeaTable.Level3Say asides, not lesson pages.
The guide only observes: it never changes the chapter phase, rewards or papers.
Fields starting with '_' are notes and are ignored by the game.

Polish pass (6 November 2026): genuinely new machine and calculator steps use the shared coach box and pointing hand (level3: targets, each resolved only while that part is the usable next action); familiar steps stay short hints. Retired or doubled lessons removed: worksheet-subtotals (old worksheet), worksheet-drafted, computation-totals (always already true), computation-done and credit-done (merged into the next step's line).

welcome.title: The Numbers Tell a Story
welcome.subtitle: TWO CLIENTS · ONE DESK CALCULATOR
welcome.tagline: Turn supported records into a computation your client can follow.

pages.text: Bea wants to know what she owes for 2026, from her own records. Check in at reception first.
Bea is waiting at her plaza table. Talk to her first.
Her records are in your Case Folder too. Ask her about anything odd.
Feed the record: drag the card into the slot, or tap card, then slot.
Choose where it belongs: turn the dial or tap a label.
Pull to file: drag the lever down, or tap it.
Same four slips. I'll say how each one went.
This one also asks why. Tap Why? and pick a reason.
Batch filed. Tap CHECK BATCH when you're ready.
A ? tab means look again: tap it, check its original, refile it.
Then tap CHECK AGAIN. Your first check stays as it was.
Accepted records are read only. Tap a total window to see what's in it.
Bea's summary is out. Tap or drag it to read.
Drag it to your Bag or a hotbar slot to keep it.
Bea's summary is in your Case Folder. Her computation is next, at your desk.
Bea's computation is in your Case Folder. Sit at your desk to start.
Tap the calculator to lift it.
Example only. Select Income, then tap the display; or drag it there.
Choose −, transfer Costs to the display, then press =.
Drag tape to the field, or select tape then tap the field.
Income, minus, deductions, equals. Drag the printed result into Taxable income.
Your turn: select Taxable income, then tap the display.
Subtract threshold, =; times rate, =; plus base tax, =. Then attach.
Find Section 7's annual bands in your Tax Code Book, then drag a band into Annual band.
Follow the formula: subtract threshold, multiply rate, add base. Press = after each, then attach Tax due.
Tax due is attached. Bea has one more paper: talk to her in the conference room.
Your turn: select Tax due, then tap the display.
Tax due − tax withheld, then =. The payment is already income.
Open her certificate from your Bag. Tax already withheld counts toward payment (Section 9).
Remaining payable is tax due minus the tax credit.
All three results are attached. Open the Case Folder and drag READY or NOT READY onto its front page.
Take the Case Folder to the Auditor. When he asks, drag it to him or tap its icon.
Start with the line he marked in the Case Folder. Fix it, stamp again, hand it back.
Approved. Collect Bea's copy beside the Auditor, then take it to her.
Bea has one question about her draft. Say only what her papers show.
The receptionist has a message for you.
